pages.title: Population of Oslo - Statistics Norway
pages.text: Statistics Norway: Oslo had 717,710 residents on 1 January 2025, up 1.2 percent from a year earlier. The growth came mostly from immigration.

pages.title: Oslo municipality - population figures
pages.text: Oslo municipality reports that the city grew by about 8,700 people in 2024, and projects continued growth of around one percent a year.
